title: ABot-ER: Unified Embodied Reasoning through Agentic Data-Model Co-Evolution
title_zh: ABot-ER：通过智能体驱动的数据模型协同进化实现统一的具身推理

paragraphs.en: ABot-ER 是一个统一的具身推理基础模型，能够同时具备感知、规划与执行能力，并在多个基准测试中取得最优性能。 We introduce \textbf{ABot Embodied Reasoning (ABot-ER)}, a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that breaks the tension between breadth and depth in embodied reasoning. Embodied intelligence demands the joint mastery of perception, planning, and execution, yet reconciling generality with specialization across this spectrum remains an open challenge. Within a single unified model, ABot-ER commands specialist-level depth across all three competencies, spanning spatial, scene, and temporal reasoning in perception; long-horizon action organization in planning; and point grounding and affordance in execution. The \textbf{Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine} continuously adapts data strategies to the model's evolving capability state. The \textbf{Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy} uses task tokens to activate lightweight low-rank residuals over a shared backbone, separating updates from heterogeneous output formats while retaining shared embodied knowledge. Across a systematic evaluation on twelve benchmarks covering three core competencies and five capability dimensions, ABot-ER achieves \textbf{state-of-the-art overall performance} across perception, planning, and execution within a unified parametric framework, demonstrating that breadth and depth can coexist in unified embodied reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: ABot-ER 是一个统一的具身推理基础模型，能够同时具备感知、规划与执行能力，并在多个基准测试中取得最优性能。我们提出 \textbf{ABot 具身推理（ABot-ER）}，一个统一的具身推理基础模型，打破了具身推理中广度与深度之间的张力。 具身智能要求对感知、规划与执行能力的协同掌握，然而在这一能力谱系中调和通用性与专业性仍然是一个未解的挑战。 在单一统一模型中，ABot-ER 在这三项能力上均具备专家级深度：感知方面涵盖空间、场景和时间推理；规划方面涉及长期动作组织；执行方面则包括点定位与功能识别。 \textbf{智能体数据模型自演化引擎} 会根据模型能力的动态变化持续调整数据策略。 \textbf{任务条件自适应训练策略} 利用任务标记，在共享主干网络上激活轻量级的低秩残差模块，从而在保留共享具身知识的同时，实现与异构输出格式的更新分离。 在涵盖三项核心能力和五个能力维度的十二项基准测试的系统性评估中，ABot-ER 在一个统一的参数化框架内实现了感知、规划与执行方面的 \textbf{当前最优整体性能}，证明了广度与深度可以在统一的具身推理中共存。
